# Tecumseh Heating & Cooling

> Tecumseh Heating & Cooling is a local HVAC company serving Tecumseh, Essex County, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Phone: (519) 979-9333  |  Email: contact@tecumsehheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://tecumsehheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Tecumseh, Windsor, LaSalle, Amherstburg, Leamington, Lakeshore, Belle River, Essex
